name: Berserk Garner
description: Let your shadow fall first, then pull the blade through the target as a hawk crosses a field.

name: Aegisgrass
description: Plant the hook against an incoming weapon like a basin's rim and hold it from sliding in.

name: Gustsheave
description: Circle the opponent on light rising steps, ready to fall onto them from above.

name: Enthralling Sicklegrip
description: Settle the hook on the opponent's wrist like a bird on a branch and tighten its grip.

name: Corroding Sheave
description: Wheel the blade overhead and slash down through the target's shoulder on the turn's far side.

name: Equipoise Tipcurve
description: Lift on a rising wave of qi under the opponent's strike and push it clear of the body.

name: Gyve Glean
description: Hang the blade motionless above the target, then seize the arm in the hook and hold it down.

name: Iron Crookspine
description: Drop from height and tear the hooked tip through the weak point of mail or hide.

name: Waning Bowbelly
description: Let the qi field spread over the ground and read every opponent's weight and stance from it.

name: Hookblade Blink
description: Vanish from one edge of the field and reappear above the target, hooking and cutting as you land.

name: Gust Sickletang
description: Draw both blades in the same direction across a target so the cuts overlap and double.

name: Ponderous Harvest
description: Weave the two hooks over and under the opponent's arms until both are held fast.

name: Unbowed Greenedge
description: Set one edge against another in opposition and take the blow where the curves meet.

name: Silt Stook
description: Alternate the feet and the blades in cross-step, one leg crossing as the opposite arm cuts.

name: Inwardbelly Scourge
description: Tap the left tip against the guard to open it and the right tip dart in behind.

name: Devastating Reap
description: Switch which blade carries the main qi in mid-stroke so the cut changes angle without a pause.

name: Suffocating Sheave
description: Hook both arms from opposite sides in mirror and cross them over the chest.

name: Chime Reapedge
description: Bounce an incoming blow from one curve to the other and send it back along its own path.

name: Maiming Hookblade
description: Hook knee and shoulder at once and heave in opposite directions to throw the target across the ground.

name: Silt Garner
description: Spin with both blades carrying separate qi and loose a double ring of cuts around the body.

name: Gyvegarner
description: Lock both hooks on one weapon and hold it motionless while qi flows through both blades.

name: Rumble Greenedge
description: Cross the blades again and again in unbroken mirrored alternation, each cut already beginning as the last ends.

name: Unseen Handleknob
description: Step from stone to stone in a ford without once looking down or letting the blade dip.

name: Impenetrable Crookspine
description: Part an incoming blow with the hook the way a stake parts water and let it pass.

name: Garnerhavoc
description: Cut along the line of a bank as it drops away, pulling the target toward the edge.

name: Thornglean
description: Hook the ankle in shallow water and drag steadily like an undertow until they lose footing.

name: Tipcurve Obduracy
description: Turn with the current's direction and let the strike run on with the water past your shoulder.

name: Reapedge Wrath
description: Send ripples of qi along the edge so the slice lands again a hand's breadth beyond the first cut.

name: Slag Handleknob
description: Gather qi like snowmelt and loose a surge of hooked cuts across everyone before you.

name: Bladedurance
description: Lay a hidden snare of qi on the shallows that hooks the ankles of the first foe to step in.

name: Phantom Harvest
description: Flash across a river's width in one motion and sink the hook into the foe on the far bank.

name: Torrent Bowbelly
description: Bow into the opponent's strike with blade angled down and turn it past the shoulder.

name: Harnessing Sicklegrip
description: Show the opponent an open flank to bait the hook, then set your own hook over theirs.

name: Sheaveglimmer
description: Pace one measured step, then its twin, keeping an exact distance from the opponent.

name: Sheavescourge
description: Draw the inner edge across, then the outer edge back along the same line.

name: Aegis Sickletang
description: Cross the haft over the opponent's weapon and lock it down against your forearm.

name: Granite Glean
description: Rotate a half turn around the opponent and slash their back line as it opens.

name: Hogtying Sicklegrip
description: Lay your hook over the enemy's hook and press both down to pin the weapon.

name: Bladenerve
description: Echo the enemy's hook motion a breath late, catch it at the apex and turn it back.

name: Shattering Tipcurve
description: Retreat two matched steps and cut on the second, catching the pursuer mid-stride.

name: Waninggrass
description: Meet the opponent's own hook motion with exactly mirrored force and send their strike back at them.

name: Thorn Stook
description: Draw the opponent steadily into a closing circle of hooks until they have nowhere left to step.

name: Pitiless Reap
description: Say nothing, stand still and pass the point through the one gap the duel has left open.

name: Thorn Hookblade
description: Set both hooks on the duelist at the moment of the decisive exchange and finish with a single cut.

name: Iron Harvest
description: Turn the palm skyward mid-draw so the blade comes up under the opponent's guard.

name: Mayhem Sheave
description: Flick dry soil off the ground with the blade's back to blind the opponent's eyes briefly.

name: Garnerruin
description: Pass the sickle from one hand to the other mid-draw and cut from the unexpected side.

name: Thorngrass
description: Hold one blade over and one under the incoming weapon to bracket it between the curves.

name: Gust Crookspine
description: Take a short brisk pace along the basin's sloping floor and arrive inside the reach.

name: Gyvestraw
description: Hook the target, then pass the haft hand over hand to haul them closer in two quick pulls.

name: Rumble Inwardbelly
description: Slash upward at a steep angle as if cutting toward the sky, the blade following a rising line of qi.

name: Decimating Stook
description: Interleave a cut from each hand into the same opening, the second following the first without a gap.

name: Immobilizing Garner
description: Gather the opponent's arms like grain with both hooks and pull them tight against the body.

name: Sickletang Havoc
description: Pour a cascade of alternating cuts from each hand, every edge fed by the field of qi.

name: Granite Bowbelly
description: Cross the blades and loose a field-wide harvest of cuts that sweeps the whole basin floor.

name: Grasswrath
description: Pull the blade up through the target with the slow lift of rising water behind the cut.

name: Torrent Reapedge
description: Slide with weight low on slick silt, the soles gripping where an opponent's would not.

name: Greenedge Hardihood
description: Pile the guard high like a floodbank with the hook angled to catch what climbs over.

name: Inwardbelly Mettle
description: Snag an arm or weapon on the hook as a snag takes drifting wood, and hold it there.

name: Rampaging Handleknob
description: Turn in a tight eddy around the blade and slash the opponent's flank as it comes round.

name: Mightstook
description: Load the chop with the weight of a flooded river and bring it down in one blow.

name: Obdurate Crookspine
description: Slip the hook back like a backwater curling away from the current and sweep the strike off.

name: Might Glean
description: Build qi along the edge over a long draw until it breaks at the crest through the guard.

name: Sheavedurance
description: Hook the opponent as waters recede and drag them backward off the ground they held.

name: Siltblade
description: Release the whole drawn weight of the edge at once in a flood of cuts across the front.

name: Shattering Sicklegrip
description: Pull the blade through the cut as if keeping a vow, without turning away from the line.

name: Flintlike Reapedge
description: Root the feet like a boulder on the plateau and take the blow on the blade without a shift.

name: Garnerdurance
description: Set the hook on a fixed bearing line and hold the opponent's arm to it.

name: Handleknob Rocketry
description: Sidestep along the lip of a drop where the opponent will not follow so close.

name: Gleanruin
description: Lead the slash with a rising gust, the blade following where the wind first points.

name: Guststraw
description: Lift the edge on a sworn line and send the strike up and over the head.

name: Hoarfrost Sickletang
description: Let the plateau wind lean on the hook and keep the caught arm pulled outward.

name: Iron Reap
description: Correct the bearing mid-stroke by a finger's width and carry the edge into the shifting target.

name: Hoarfrost Inwardbelly
description: Hook the foe and drag them across open ground along your bearing, cutting as they stumble.

name: Greenedge Valor
description: Keep your ground as vowed, turn the blow aside and strike back along its own line.

name: Rumbleblade
description: Swear the cut to the open sky and drive the point through any guard that shelters below.

name: Sheave Ruin
description: Pull the blade across under a bare sky with nothing to catch or hamper the stroke.

name: Murkstraw
description: Fan the blade in a wide arc to cover all sides where no wall stands behind you.

name: Might Bowbelly
description: Take a long stride toward the horizon line, and another, and keep the distance open.

name: Gyve Hookblade
description: Hook from the far edge of your reach and draw the target in across the open ground.

name: Rumblereap
description: Flick the edge so the wind carries a streak of qi into the opponent's eyes.

name: Punishing Tipcurve
description: Sweep from the skyline down in an arc that both turns the strike and cuts the striker.

name: Downpour Glean
description: Loose a sweeping hook of qi outward in every direction across ground that has no walls to stop it.

name: Toxinsheave
description: Hook beneath the weapon and pull it up and away into the open air.

name: Hour Stook
description: Reach out across the whole plain in one flash, the blade arriving before the sound of the step.

name: Might Reap
description: Draw the edge in time with a gust so wind and arm travel together through the cut.

name: Thorn Handleknob
description: Lean into the wind with the blade braced across the chest and let it hold you up.

name: Vanishing Crookspine
description: Run down a fleeing opponent with the wind at your back, matching its speed stride for stride.

name: Thorn Sicklegrip
description: Tug the hook at the instant a gust hits the opponent's sleeve and pull them half a pace.

name: Tempered Sickletang
description: Skim the edge flat across the opponent's lead arm so only the outermost cut lands.

name: Stookhavoc
description: Spin the whole body with the blade extended and feed the spin with qi until it slashes in a ring.

name: Gyvesheave
description: Wrap a gust around the hook so its pull is far stronger than the arm alone.

name: Unconquered Inwardbelly
description: Turn the blade across the wind so the gust itself shoves the incoming strike aside.

name: Stookscourge
description: Drive the cut forward with the wind pressing on the blade's back and the legs thrusting behind.

name: Vengeful Reap
description: Call a broad gust along the blade and sweep a swath of cuts across every foe in front.

name: Wrathful Glean
description: Shear the hook through a strap or joint on a gust of qi and tear the guard apart.

name: Mangling Harvest Havoc
description: Let the whole wind gather into the blade and flash through the foe in a single unseen cut.

name: Devastating Bowbelly
description: Cut along a bearing taken at the top of the stroke and do not drift from it.

name: Tipcurve Whirlpool
description: Step in time with the held breath of thin air so that no stride is wasted.

name: Ironblade
description: Hold the blade with a frost-stiff grip that no jolt can shake loose.

name: Hoarfrost Reapedge
description: Set the hook on the sworn bearing and bring the opponent's arm onto that line.

name: Iron Garner
description: Lunge down the held bearing, the blade point and edge both aligned to the target.

name: Adamantine Hookblade
description: Turn the strike aside, reset to the same bearing and be ready again with no lost beat.

name: Numbing Stook
description: Pull the hooked arm in with slow, even qi, without any jerk that would let it slip.

name: Sicklegrip Valor
description: Stay unshaken on the bearing as the blow lands wide, then cut the extended arm.

name: Sheave Reckoning
description: Drag the hooked blade across the opponent's guard on a long steady line and cut as it parts.

name: Indomitable Aegis Bowbelly
description: Hold the bearing through the full assault, then answer it with one strike that carries every stored force.

name: Ponderous Garner
description: Face into the wind and draw the hook toward you, pulling the opponent into it.

name: Chimeblade
description: Swear the blade's edge to a line and parry along it so no blow crosses.

name: Siltreap
description: Hop among the plateau's loose stones with weight forward and the blade held level.

name: Mayhem Glean
description: Set the hook over the shoulder and tug so the opponent's stance twists toward the drop.

name: Reapruin
description: Slice quickly into the wind, the headwind sharpening the cut's snap.

name: Chime Crookspine
description: Walk the edge and catch the pursuer's weapon arm in a counter hook as they follow.

name: Iron Tipcurve
description: Drag the edge through the target in a long slow slice that does not break or turn away.

name: Grievous Harvest
description: Lunge from the windward side, the wind at your shoulders, and cut the exposed neck line.

name: Fastening Handleknob
description: Reverse the hook mid-pull so the opponent's own pull carries them past you.

name: Overpowering Garner
description: Hook the foe on the windward edge and tip them over the drop, cutting as they go.

name: Evergreen Inwardbelly
description: Hold the cliff line against a rush, turn the strike on the blade and answer with the tip.

name: Enthralling Sheave
description: Strip the grip from the enemy's weapon hand with a wind-driven hook and a twist.

name: Overbearing Reap Valor
description: Swear the hook to the cliff edge itself, pin the target to it and drive the point home.

name: Pitiless Stook
description: Draw the cut on the leading edge of a storm front as the first heavy drops hit.

name: Granite Sickletang
description: Rotate the blade's flat to shed rain and a blow alike, the grip locked against wetness.

name: Facet Harvest
description: Stab the tip at the instant thunder rolls so the strike lands under its cover.

name: Blinding Reap
description: Pick a narrow lane through blowing rain and step along it without breaking the line.

name: Overbearing Greenedge
description: Tug the hook once on slick mud and let the opponent's footing do the rest.

name: Thornblade
description: Pull the hook along a rain-slick arm to catch at the wrist and haul forward.

name: Equipoise Hookblade
description: Sweep across the storm's line to turn a strike and cut the striker's wrist in the same arc.

name: Iron Reapedge
description: Bring the chop down from a towering lift like a thunderhead breaking over a ridge.

name: Overbearing Bowbelly
description: Cross the storm's line, hook the foe and hurl them against the wind with the cut.

name: Strawnerve
description: Stand calm in the midst of the assault like a storm's still center and turn each strike into a cut.

name: Reapedge Ruin
description: Flash through the rain-dark in one clean line and pass the point through the foe between thunderclaps.
